title: Page 149
transc:
to some safe smoky further 
North there bring great danger
of them being released and
armed by wilcoxes at these
places signed S G Burbridge
Brevet Vienna Vernon quote end


6 PM
Aug 7 1864
Kelly Cumberland Md
Camel Aug postpone Julia for palate Averill
Comdg panama Quitman ---- Pine your pacific
pontiac at Han Cock & Swindle me
with out delay by the shortest &
most practicable route ---- You can ascertain
where I am by wrangling to Shelby
Howe poking cancer Webster Nabob Delr soon


L. F. Sheldon  Wash'n Aug 7th 1864
Grapes Aug Plunder Rosetta For Palsy H W Wessels
John left here this after noon and will be
at Animal Wheaton morning zebra Please apply to him
for orders yoke Italy mighty warm day this sir
